newsitem.title: FRANCE: Cr Foncier profit rises further - paper.
newsitem.headline: Cr Foncier profit rises further - paper.

text.p: Credit Foncier de France will post a net attributable profit of around 660 million francs for the nine months to September 30, Les Echos newspaper quoted a trade union delegation at the property lender as saying.
The newspaper also said the unions had been told by Credit Foncier chairman Jerome Meyssonier that the full-year result could head for a billion francs.

State bank CDC is in the process of taking over Credit Foncier under a government plan to wind down the property lender after huge losses and provisions written into its 1995 accounts. Unions say its profit so far this year is proof it is viable.
